story.title: Changes at Google DeepMind: Demis Hassabis from CEO to Chair, Jeff Dean departs

draft:
Demis Hassabis is stepping down as CEO of Google DeepMind to become Chair. 
I'm intrigued by this move, as it signals a shift in leadership. 
Key changes include Jeff Dean's departure. 
What does this mean for AI development at Google? 
#AI #GoogleDeepMind #TechLeadership
